related.title: 三維視覺散料揀選
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：不把像素或小數位當準確度，保留標準件及視野位置的驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Neither pixels nor decimal places are called accuracy; reference and field-position checks remain.
related.difference: 由視差推深度並評估遠距誤差放大，把可見點與可抓取姿態分開。
related.differenceEn: Infer depth from disparity and assess distant-error amplification, distinguishing visible points from graspable poses.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 長度L=sp；獨立兩端邊緣σp=√(σ1²+σ2²)，uL²=(sσp)²+(p us)²，僅適用局部線性模型。 合成比例s=0.020 mm/px、跨度p=500 px，兩邊緣各0.10 px標準不確定度，比例相對不確定度0.1%。 L=10.000 mm；邊緣貢獻0.002828 mm，比例貢獻0.010 mm，合成u=√(0.002828²+0.010²)=0.010392 mm。
校正平行雙目Z=fB/d；小誤差uZ≈fB ud/d²，f與d同用像素。 教學f=800 px，基線B=0.10 m，視差d=40 px，視差標準不確定度0.5 px。 Z=800×0.10/40=2.0 m；uZ≈800×0.10×0.5/40²=0.025 m。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: L=sp; independent endpoint error σp=√(σ1²+σ2²), withuL²=(s σp)²+(p us)² under a local linear model. Synthetic s 0.020 mm/px, span 500 px, each edge uncertainty 0.10 px and relative scale uncertainty 0.1%. L=10.000 mm; edge contribution 0.002828 mm, scale contribution 0.010 mm, combinedu=0.010392 mm.
For rectified stereo Z=fB/d and small-erroruZ≈fB ud/d², with f and d both in pixels. Teaching f 800 px, baseline 0.10 m, disparity 40 px and disparity uncertainty 0.5 px. Z=2.0 m; uZ≈0.025 m.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 量測系統分析 GRR
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：不把像素或小數位當準確度，保留標準件及視野位置的驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Neither pixels nor decimal places are called accuracy; reference and field-position checks remain.
related.difference: 正確合成標準差，區分量測變異占總變異與占公差寬度兩種指標。
related.differenceEn: Combine standard deviations correctly and distinguish study-variation fraction from tolerance fraction.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 長度L=sp；獨立兩端邊緣σp=√(σ1²+σ2²)，uL²=(sσp)²+(p us)²，僅適用局部線性模型。 合成比例s=0.020 mm/px、跨度p=500 px，兩邊緣各0.10 px標準不確定度，比例相對不確定度0.1%。 L=10.000 mm；邊緣貢獻0.002828 mm，比例貢獻0.010 mm，合成u=√(0.002828²+0.010²)=0.010392 mm。
獨立變異分量相加，σGRR=√(σrepeat²+σoperator²)；百分比定義需固定，不能直接加標準差。 合成重複性σ0.004 mm、操作者σ0.003 mm、零件σ0.020 mm，公差寬0.20 mm。 σGRR=0.005 mm；6σGRR/公差=15%；σGRR/√(0.020²+0.005²)=24.254%（研究變異比）。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: L=sp; independent endpoint error σp=√(σ1²+σ2²), withuL²=(s σp)²+(p us)² under a local linear model. Synthetic s 0.020 mm/px, span 500 px, each edge uncertainty 0.10 px and relative scale uncertainty 0.1%. L=10.000 mm; edge contribution 0.002828 mm, scale contribution 0.010 mm, combinedu=0.010392 mm.

Independent variances add:σ GRR=√(σ repeat²+σ operator²); define percentages consistently instead of adding standard deviations. Synthetic repeatability σ0.004 mm, operator σ0.003 mm, part σ0.020 mm, tolerance width 0.20 mm. σ GRR=0.005 mm;6 σ GRR/tolerance=15%;σ GRR/√(0.020²+0.005²)=24.254% study-variation fraction.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
